reviews.x: I don’t think this is an actual slip face mask. The quality isn’t that good. I bought a 13 dollar silk mask and it’s 100 times better then this one

reviews.t: NOT  the  quality I expected for the HIGH PRICE
reviews.x: Double layered (that's a positive) but it gives a medium coverage ( a couple of more inches longer it would have been ideal)  and the material for some reason has two vertical stitches in the inner layer (?). It gives a bulky aspect since the material is kind of thick. I was not impressed at all with this "face mask" . Nope! Definitely not worth the high price. I purchased another silk mask for $14 and is way better than this one, but sadly, they didn't have any more colors available.

Fits tighter than the paper masks and my very sensitive skin does not get annoyed wearing it for almost 8 hours a day.  The bands for the ears are painful after a while though and it is harder to breathe through than the paper or cotton ones.

reviews.t: Great for sensitive skin, sweaty faces, and as a glitzy mask option
reviews.x: I have two of this mask in black, and I wear them almost every day. I finally got one in this rose pink color, and it’s a lovely tone to sit next to your skin—not too light to almost blend into your face if you have a paler complexion (this happens with a gold mask I have). This mask is PERFECT if you have sensitive skin, sweat a lot under your mask, or both. My nose was getting chafed from cotton/blend masks, and I had to search for alternatives. The Slip masks are, by far, the highest quality

If you’re someone struggling from maskne, get this mask!!! I do agree it’s a bit pricey for a mask but I have definitely placed another order for more so that should say something. I’ve been struggling from severe maskne. Never experienced acne like this in my life and I’m in my mid 20s. I decided to switch to silk masks due to a couple recommendations and omg, what a difference. You definitely feel the difference on your skin. DoEsnt rub or tug against it. It also doesn’t get muggy and moist in
Very soft and comfortable. Breathable and can be worn for long periods of time. Very gentle on skin. Would recommend for anyone that needs to wear a mask all day at work

reviews.t: Love it! This mask fits well and does not irritate my skin.
reviews.x: I like everything about this mask. . They are very well made. Soft on the skin, fits perfectly on my face. I have sensitive skin and I can not wear synthetic material. I even bought the second pair because they dont irritate my skin. It really worth the price.  If you want quality mask then get it, if you are looking for something cheap and dont care about the quality then this is not the one for you.

Full coverage, silk, nose wire, adjustable ear elastic.  Perfection! Best silk face mask on the market. The ones on etsy are nice, but most slip down or are too small in regards of coverage.  This brand nailed it! I purchased silk so I dont sweat all day at work in the cotton ones. I have rosacea and silk doesn't irritate it. Great buy!

I'm not going to lie. I saw Taylor Swift wearing this face covering at the SNL after party and it looked so fabulous and comfortable that I had to get it. It is pricey, but I think it's worth it. Gentle on the face, super soft, breathable. Love that it has a wire noseband so it fits nice and snug. The adjustable straps are also really convenient! I would recommend this.

Very good quality but if you want to breath at ease, this is not for you. It is very soft and does not itch you face or fall down, but when you talk and breath in, it goes with every breath you take and it feels like you cant breathe bc it is to thick and heavy. The upside ,,,,, it is very silky soft and great made... downside,,,, you can not breath well....

Best face mask ever 100% worth the money This mask is great for sensitive skin and for people who have asthma bc I have both and I wear this mask all day at school and basically everywhere I go and it's really comfortable and soft at the inside and it's not super thick and easy to breathe through

I’m so disgusted I received a USED mask. It had someone’s entire face of makeup on it and had a slight tear. Literally soooooo disappointed. Really makes you realize masks are so risky to purchase on Amazon. Clearly no quality control at all.

Love that it is silk on both sides. Super comfy & breathable. Perfect for professional looks, and the nudish-pink is a perfect neutral to match everything. Adjustable ear bands are great. Get tons of compliments. No more maskne! Hallelujah!

I bought two pink, one as a gift. Mask is beautiful and feels soft. But it is hot and inner layer is a separate piece that gets in your mouth while breathing. Nose wire fell out. Gift recipient had similar experience.

reviews.t: Wished it has a filter pocket
reviews.x: Very elegant and smooth, helps prevent maskne as well. Would be nice if it has pocket to place filter in.

reviews.t: The Only Mask I Can Tolerate Wearing
reviews.x: I have tried so many masks -- disposable, n95, double cotton, single silk. I can barely get through the grocery store with them on. All of them. I feel like I can't get enough air. I'm suffocating. (Ok maybe it's mental, but it's still a problem!)  Additionally, I have VERY sensitive skin and all masks were making my rosacea worse.  ... until I bought this Blissy mask. The inside material is so so soft. It's cotton but breathable. The outside is silk. I have 2 Blissy pillowcases and I would HIGH

This mask is so beautiful and the quality went well beyond my expectations! The fabric is so soft! The adjustable nose wire is hidden which is nice, and the inner part of the mask is structured very well and thoughtfully(two seams going vertically). Probably my favorite “cloth” mask to date. Love!

I ordered this to help with mask acne and to prevent makeup from smudging. I have been using this mask for about 2 months now and love it. I have not had a breakout and my makeup stays on. Also very easy to clean, just make sure to air dry flat to help keep the shape since it is 100&% silk.

There is nothing I don't like about this mask! It's beautiful, soft and it is perfectly sized for my petite face.  Most adult masks are huge on me, so I was pleasantly surprised.  I even bought the animal/leopard print version, not usually my style but doesn't look tacky. :)

Love the slip silk face masks! This is my third! And I’ve even gifted one to someone for the holidays! They are an easy way to dress up your outfit from your regular face mask. Summer perk: They also keep you cool when it’s hot outside but you still have to wear a mask!!!
The Slip silk face mask is the most comfortable mask I have worn yet. The coverage over the nose is snug, and stays put! The best thing is my glasses do not fog up!!! That is worth the cost to me.
These masks are the softest most comfortable masks I have ever worn. However..... They SHRINK... BAD. Its a bummer. After one wash the 2 that I ordered are no longer wearable.
Fabric Feels So Nice Against The Skin . Breathable ! Beautiful Color ! Yes The Price Is Pretty Steep , would be nice if for the price it was a pack of Atleast 2 or 3 .
Received my shipment without the product inside. Ordered the Slip mask and only received an instruction packet and wire nose pieces, no mask.
The color is nice and definitely more elegant that a traditional mask. Silk is also an anti-microbial fabric. Well-made mask.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the mask soft, comfortable, and gentle on sensitive skin, often wearing it for long periods.
Several reviewers say it helps prevent or improve maskne and suits sensitive or acne-prone skin.
Some reviewers find it hard to breathe through or too thick and heavy, and a few mention the ear bands being painful or the inner layer getting in the mouth.
A number of reviewers consider it pricey but worth the money, while others feel the quality does not justify the high price.
Some reviewers praise the fit, coverage, and adjustable ear bands or nose wire, while others report issues like the nose wire falling out or insufficient coverage.
